text: Implemented a typed f+h+g(Kx) compiler. Certified PSD quadratic pullbacks stay smooth; at most one proof-bearing exact direct prox is admitted; transformed L1/TV terms are stacked matrix-free and solved by a new portable Condat--Vu kernel. Operator bounds are derived columnwise and stacked with a provenance-bearing root-sum-square bound, so callers cannot supply optimistic bounds. Fits independently recompute objective parts, fixed-point/KKT residuals, dual feasibility, and a strong-convexity-corrected Fenchel gap before admitting EpsilonGlobal. Rejections cover denominator loadings, indefinite PSD certification, unsupported split functionals/prox sums, non-finite inputs, and dimension/parameter mismatches. Evidence: linalg 52/52 JVM and 52/52 JS; multivar 381/381 JVM and 381/381 JS; focused composite suite 9/9 on each platform, including analytic 1D/2D, exhaustive convex grid, derivative/spline, sparse-group, L1+TV, per-block permutation, nullspace/zero operator, and extreme penalties; git diff --check and mote doctor clean.
